structuredData.headline: Pavillion Ceylon Contemporary Elegance — Luxury 2-Bedroom Condo Renovation in Kuala Lumpur
structuredData.description: A 2-bedroom luxury condominium at Pavillion Ceylon in Kuala Lumpur renovated in 2024 on an RM 22,000 budget. Features contemporary classic styling with decorative wall panelling, a light grey tufted sofa, mauve-and-grey abstract rug, terrazzo flooring in common areas, dark wood dining set, glossy white kitchen with glass backsplash, and mustard-yellow panelled bedrooms with navy upholstered headboards.
